node-1.label: A 50-year-old man presented with subjective fevers, shortness of breath, and worsening cough for 6 days

node-2.label: Patient has medical history of CVID on IVIG every 3 weeks, HIV with undetectable viral load and CD4 count 140 cells/µL on therapy, chronic bronchiectasis with history of Mycobacterium avium complex pulmonary infection, recurrent giardiasis, myopathy on long-term low-dose prednisone, and recurrent herpes simplex virus infections

node-3.label: 14 months prior, patient presented with pharyngitis and was on trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole for Pneumocystis prophylaxis

node-4.label: Physical examination showed oxygen saturation 97% on room air, developed bilateral lower-extremity edema, and ulceration of the glans penis noted during treatment course
